from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCriminalAnalysis(BaseModel):
    """Criminal case information extracted from a single document."""
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of the current document (e.g., '刑事二审终审裁定书', '民事执行复议裁定书')")
    document_case_number: str | None = Field(description="The case number of the current document")
    is_criminal_case: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this document involves a criminal case")
    charge_names: list[str] = Field(description="Names of criminal charges identified in the document (e.g., '诈骗罪', '盗窃罪')")
    charge_legal_category: list[str] = Field(description="Legal classification of the identified charges (e.g., '侵犯财产罪', '破坏金融管理秩序罪')")
    underlying_judgment_number: str | None = Field(description="Case number of the underlying judgment referenced (e.g., '(2023) 青 0104 刑初 239 号'), if the document is a ruling based on a prior judgment")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCriminalAnalysis]
